Method of Attack: Remote code execution by injecting malicious code in source rules
Unauthorized access to configuration objects to obtain administrative rights
Impacted Systems: Migration Service component in NetWeaver software stack versions 7.10, 7.11, 7.30, 7.31, 7.40, 7.50
Attack Vector: Exploitation of browser control (Chromium) in SAP Business Client
Exploitation of Backoffice Product Content Management application in SAP Commerce
Missing authorization check in Migration Service
